zh-CN.title: π₀：机器人怎样把“看懂任务”变成连续动作
zh-CN.summary: 从 VLM 语义骨干、连续动作专家到 Conditional Flow Matching，逐层解释 π₀ 如何把视觉、语言与本体状态变成可执行的动作块。

en.title: π₀: How a Robot Turns Understanding into Continuous Action
en.summary: A layered account of the VLM backbone, continuous action expert, and Conditional Flow Matching that turn vision, language, and proprioception into executable action chunks.

paper.title: π₀: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
